name: Innosphere
evidence: Science/tech incubator (Fort Collins). Launched a 2025 Life Sciences Accelerator with 33 startups (national showcase Dec 2025) and announced its 2026 Life Sciences Incubator cohort in May 2026. Structured, cohort-based, active.

name: Third Derivative
evidence: Climate-tech accelerator (RMI + New Energy Nexus) unveiled a new 26-startup, 13-country cohort focused on hard-tech deployment in May 2026; runs an 18-month structured accelerator with recurring cohorts. On-file domain redirects to www.third-derivative.org.

name: Startup Colorado
evidence: Rural-entrepreneur support network; primarily a peer network but runs structured cohort programming, including the Founder Coopetition / 'Idea Factory' four-week accelerator with weekly cohort sessions, and launched a Rural Angel Investor Network in 2025. More of a support network than a classic equity accelerator, so throughput is a rough estimate.

name: Catalyst Accelerator
evidence: Defense/space accelerator (Catalyst Campus, Colorado Springs) running back-to-back cohorts: CADEW cohort held Demo Day Jan 15 2026 (15th cohort), and the 16th cohort (AI/ML Orchestrator for USSF Delta 7) began Jan 12 2026 with 6 companies; applications solicited Sept 2025.

name: CatalyzeCU
evidence: CU Boulder's equity-free summer student startup accelerator. On-file domain catalyzecu.com serves only a 'Hello World :-)' placeholder page, but the real active program lives at colorado.edu/catalyzecu with a 2025 cohort (applications March-April 2025, program mid-May to early August).

name: LabStart
evidence: 501(c)(3) climate-tech fellowship that matches undercapitalized founders with national-lab / market-ready technologies; site shows Cohort 2027 applications open with an October 9 deadline and current funders including the U.S. Department of Energy. Alumni (e.g. Mars Materials) went on to Greentown Labs and Breakthrough Energy.

name: Telluride Venture Network
evidence: TVN (Telluride Foundation initiative) ran a 2025 Climate Solutions Investment Bootcamp cohort of eight climate/cleantech startups (Green Steel Environmental, New Day Hydrogen, Sustainable Chemicals, EVchargeME, etc.) and hosts a recurring Pitch Day. Structured, cohort-based investor-readiness program.

name: The Warehouse Business Accelerator
evidence: Active nonprofit (501c3, founded 2013) running the 4-month cohort-based 'Make It Accelerator' for Northern Colorado technology and manufacturing startups; applications are currently OPEN for the Fall 2026 cohort. Genuine active-but-under-covered target.

name: Fulcrum Venture Accelerator
evidence: Fundraising accelerator (founded 2019 by Will Sacks). On-file domain redirects to the rebranded fulcrumventures.io (same org). Ran its 7th 'Fundraising Mastery' cohort in mid-2023; 2024 was a consolidation year after which it moved to a bespoke (non-cohort) model. No cohort-based program signal since 2023.

name: CanopyBoulder
evidence: Cannabis-ancillary accelerator (founded 2014, ~51 portfolio cos). On-file domain (www.canopyboulder.com and go.canopyboulder.com) no longer resolves/serves (connection timeout / SSL failure Aug 2026). No accelerator cohort announced since ~2019-2020; program appears wound down. Last Dealroom round 2019.

name: Unreasonable at Sea
evidence: One-off transnational entrepreneurship accelerator run aboard Semester at Sea; inaugural (and effectively only) voyage sailed Jan 2013 with 10 teams. On-file domain unreasonableatsea.org does not connect (Aug 2026); content now lives only as an archived initiative page under unreasonablegroup.com. Program discontinued.

name: London Trust Media
evidence: London Trust Media was the owner of the Private Internet Access VPN (its consumer business was absorbed by Kape Technologies around 2019), not a cohort-based accelerator. The on-file domain londontrustmedia.com now 301-redirects to imperialfamily.com, an unrelated 'sovereign holding company', so the brand is gone.
priority_tier: DROP: Updated to company type, outside tech - https://app.dealroom.co/companies/london_trust_media

name: Global Venture Network
evidence: Site is live and active but explicitly describes itself as a private membership peer network for the leaders of accelerators, venture studios and innovation hubs (850+ members, 50+ countries) - it runs advisory forums and capital-matching summits (dated Sep/Oct 2025 and Jan/Feb 2026), not startup cohorts. It states it is 'not a founder community'.

name: Story Stock Exchange
evidence: The on-file domain storystockexchange.com now 302-redirects to a HugeDomains 'domain for sale' listing, with no surviving program content. No evidence of any active cohort, exchange or mentored-company program.

name: 29 South Co
evidence: Site is live (2026 copyright) but describes a private-capital firm using a 'blended incubation, venture, and control investment model' to invest in middle-market energy/manufacturing/industrial companies. No cohorts, application cycles or demo days - a direct-investment firm, not a cohort accelerator.

name: Colorado Center for Innovation in Community Capital
evidence: The on-file domain cc4icc.com does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND / no A record) and no active web presence for the organization could be found. Name suggests a community-capital/finance initiative rather than a startup cohort accelerator; cannot confirm any program activity.

name: Innovation Center of the Rockies
evidence: ICR was a Boulder nonprofit incubator that helped commercialize university/federal-lab research, but it merged into Innosphere (announced ~2016) and no longer operates as a standalone brand. The on-file domain returns HTTP 410 Gone; commercialization activity now runs under Innosphere Ventures.

name: UpRamp
evidence: UpRamp was CableLabs' genuine startup accelerator (the 3-month 'Fiterator', ~4 startups/cohort). CableLabs mothballed the Fiterator after a three-year run and its page confirms the UpRamp program is discontinued (stated Nov 2025); the on-file domain upramp.com no longer resolves (DNS ENOTFOUND).

name: Handshakin Pre-Accelerator
evidence: handshakin.com now 301-redirects to handshaking.com, which is a Denver marketing agency doing real-estate contractor lead generation and 'AI Receptionist' services (copyright 2014-2022), not a startup accelerator. The former Handshakin 'pre-accelerator' was a light 8-evening entrepreneur community tied to a personal brand, not a cohort startup accelerator, and shows no program activity since ~2022.
priority_tier: DROP: Updated to company type, outside tech - https://app.dealroom.co/companies/handshaking

name: Info Media
evidence: InfoMedia Inc (a Joel Comm company, founded 1995, Loveland CO) is a marketing/multimedia services firm, not a cohort-based startup accelerator; the live site shows only branding with a 2026 copyright and no incubation program, cohorts, or portfolio. Its self-description as an 'incubator' refers to marketing systems, not startup acceleration.
priority_tier: DROP: Updated to company type and merged with another record

name: Denver Accelerator
evidence: The on-file domain denveraccelerator.com does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) and no accelerator program operating under the generic name 'Denver Accelerator' surfaces in web searches of Denver's accelerator/incubator ecosystem. No evidence of a genuine cohort program; likely defunct or generic listing.

name: Inside Sales Bootcamp
evidence: Inside Sales Bootcamp (founded 2016, Boulder) was a career/sales bootcamp training individuals for entry-level tech sales jobs, not a startup accelerator. It was acquired by Vendition in April 2017 and the on-file domain insidesalesbootcamp.com no longer resolves (DNS ENOTFOUND).

name: SecureSet Accelerator
evidence: SecureSet (Denver cybersecurity org, founded 2014) was acquired by Flatiron School in August/September 2019 and fully integrated under the Flatiron brand by January 2022; the SecureSet name/program is retired and the on-file domain securesetaccelerator.com does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND).

name: CanopyBoulder 2016
evidence: Duplicate of the main CanopyBoulder cannabis/hemp seed-stage accelerator (Boulder). Its accelerator program ran ~2015-2020 (last cohort Winter 2020, ~10 startups) and wound down after seven years; no new cohort since. The domain still appears indexed (HOME page) but shows no program activity since 2020 (direct fetch was refused).
